subject: Logic
title: What Is Probability
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on What Is Probability.

hook.text: Will it rain tomorrow? You can't know for sure—but you can assign a number to the uncertainty.

buildup.text: Probability measures how likely an event is, on a scale from 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain).

discovery.text: A fair coin toss is 0.5. Drawing an ace from a full deck is 4/52, about 0.077.

twist.text: Probability isn't about predicting individual events. It's about patterns across many repetitions.

climax.text: Understanding probability means accepting uncertainty while still making smarter decisions.

quiz.question: What does a probability of 0 mean?
